这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 Pony 文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过使用“图像保存程序简单”节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。您将在生成的每个图像的可读 .txt 文件中以这种方式获得提示（匹配 Automatic1111 / EasyDiffusion 的 .txt 输出） -

正如您所看到的，如果您想在不同的工具（如 WebUI Forge 或 Easy Diffusion 或其他工具）上重复使用提示，这非常具有可读性，并且非常适合轻松参考重用。这可以保存 LORA 的权重以及带有提示的正负嵌入。我只是让这个工作流程相当简单，并且只使用一种推荐的正嵌入和一种推荐的负嵌入。 （当然，您可以自由修改工作流程并添加更多内容，但这将使工作流程变得太不稳定）。

您可以从CivitAI下载您所需的Pony模型和使用的LORA（详情见下文）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件（Pony 模型、LORA 等）放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 和 Flux.1 的其他工作流程。随意在您喜欢的东西上扔一些黄色的嗡嗡声。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需首先选择您想要的 Pony 模型和嵌入即可

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用。要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮，在新选项卡上使用 LORA Manager 找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的风筝按钮。对于许多 Pony 模型来说，选择该模型推荐的正负嵌入至关重要，但当然可以禁用或绕过这些嵌入。

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your Pony Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work seperately. You will get your prompts in this way inside a readable .txt file for each image generated (matching Automatic1111 / EasyDiffusion's .txt outputs) -

Positive Prompt -

------------------

(embedding:CyberRealisticPony_POSV1:0.500), score_9, score_8_up, (Only_Saree:1.4), source_realistic, (cinematic photography style), masterpiece, high quality, ((beautiful eyes)), A stunning cinematic photograph of an Indian actress, capturing her graceful dance under the pouring rain near a mesmerizing waterfall. She is adorned in a wet, blouseless, no-sleeve Purple saree with a single shoulder, revealing her toned belly. Her dark hair is cascading down her back, and her eyes are filled with a deep sense of connection to the elements around her. The background showcases the powerful waterfall, with raindrops and water droplets enhancing the vivid colors of the scene., cinematic, photo, Woman in Saree, OnlySaree_Pony_Style, Wearing a BlouseLess BraLess SleeveLess OneShoulder Saree, Exposed Belly Button <lora:OnlySaree_Pony_2.0:1.0> < lora:Desi_Tabela_v3_PDXL_LoRA_prodigy_local:0.5>

Negative Prompt -

------------------

(embedding:CyberRealistic_Negative_PONY_V2-neg:0.500), score_6, score_5, score_4, pony, furry, child, kid, chibi, 3d, elven ears, anime, nipple,asian, male, huge teeth, ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, low contrast, deformed, bad anatomy, bad face, ugly, missing, glasses, missing fingers, extra fingers, bra, panty, blouse, underwear, fat, chubby, pregnent, old

Seed - 84005258444181

Steps - 50

CFG - 8.0

Sampler - euler

Denoise Strength - 1.0

As you can see this is very much readable and ideal for easy reference reuse if you want to reuse the prompt on a different tool like WebUI Forge or Easy Diffusion or something else. This saves both the weights of LORAs along with positive & negative embeddings with the prompt. I just kept this workflow fairly simple and used only one recommended positive embedding and only one recommended negative embedding. (of course you are free to modify the workflow and add more, but that will make the workflow too wonkey).

You can download your necessary Pony model and LORA used from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files (Pony model, LORAs etc) in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein and Flux.1 . Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on stuffs you like.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Pony model and embeddings first and now

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs. to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button. For many Pony models it is vital to select that model's recommended positive & negative embeddings but can ofcourse disable or bypass these.
